name: Contribution-Based Normalization
definition: A densification criterion that normalizes the accumulated gradient by the accumulated average contribution of the Gaussian's rendered views, rather than the raw number of views in which the Gaussian was visible in the frustum.
summary: Contribution-Based Normalization is a 3D Gaussian Splatting densification criterion that normalizes photometric gradients by average rendering contribution, solving occlusion-induced bias by reflecting actual image influence rather than geometric footprint.
